name: VERISH' NE VERISH'
description: Verish' Ne Verish' ('Believe It or Not') is the Russian version of BS/Cheat. 2-6+ players. Deal all cards. Play face-down declaring rank. Players call 'Ne Veryu!' to challenge. Wrong challengee picks up pile; wrong challenger picks up pile. Shed all cards to win.

content.text: Verish' Ne Verish' ('Believe It or Not') is the Russian version of BS/Cheat. 2-6+ players. Deal all cards. Play face-down declaring rank. Players call 'Ne Veryu!' to challenge. Wrong challengee picks up pile; wrong challenger picks up pile. Shed all cards to win.

Verish' Ne Verish' is the Russian equivalent of I Doubt It (Cheat/BS). The name means 'Trust - don't trust'. It belongs to the worldwide family of shedding games where players play face-down, declare ranks, and may be challenged. The game is played in Russia as a family and casual game.

items.text: I trust and expose: Player may say I trust and expose previous play; if lied they pick up, if truth cards go to discard and they start next round. Often no four-of-a-kind discard.
No fours discard: Players may not discard sets of four equal cards; legal to start a round by playing four cards.
Last card wait: When a player plays their last cards they must wait until turn comes again and then trust or not trust; if wrong they pick up and stay in the game.
